one_liner: Nifty 50 falls 1.64% amid broad-based market decline.

drivers.title: FII Selling
drivers.detail: FIIs net sellers in cash market.

drivers.title: Crude Oil Spike
drivers.detail: Brent crude surged 5.35%, raising inflation concerns.

flows_line: FIIs sold Rs 12,943.58 crore; DIIs bought Rs 10,703.11 crore.
watch_next: Watch for UoM Consumer Sentiment data at 23:30 IST tomorrow.
lesson_seeds: Broad-based declines can occur without a specific catalyst.
Volatility spikes often accompany market downturns.
FII selling pressure can significantly impact market sentiment.
Rising crude prices may signal inflationary pressures.
